title: Masterclass: Quartz Formulation & Natural Cobalt Glazing
format: Interactive Live Zoom + DIY Raw Materials Kit option
description: Learn the chemical secrets of how quartz stone and glass cullet are transformed into unglazed paste, watch Master Rameshwar live on his foot wheel, and learn how copper and cobalt oxide pigments react in wood-fired kilns.

title: The Sacred Alchemy of Natural Indigo Fermentation
format: Live from Kutch Studio + Q&A with Master Khatri
description: Experience the 400-year-old living indigo fermentation vats of Dhamadka. Master Abdul Rahim explains the natural bacteria feeding cycles with jaggery and dates, and demonstrates synchronous double-sided wooden block stamping.

title: Mithila Motifs & Line Storytelling with Natural Bamboo Nibs
format: Interactive Step-by-Step Workshop + Downloadable Motif Guide
description: Dip your pen or bamboo stick into natural pigments with Shobha Devi. Learn the foundational lines of the sacred Fish, Peacock, and Sun motifs, and discover the folk proverbs chanted while painting.
